Client research · September 17, 2026

Sets, PvP, bosses & instances

Explore build 1.60.1.69876: set bonuses, PvP ranks and rewards, new battlegrounds and dungeon encounters, with Classic and Season of Discovery comparisons.

18 new Tier 1 class/role sets: six member IDs each, with bonuses at 2, 3, 4 and 5 pieces. “Tier 1” comes from the internal bonus spell names.

The 108 referenced tier items have no ItemSparse metadata in this snapshot. Item stats, drop sources and raid assignments remain unverified.

PvP findings · Download PvP data · Technical sources

Raid announcements and client records have different coverage. Blizzard announced Hyjal Summit (20 players) and Barrow Deeps (10 players). No newly added map is typed as a raid in the inspected build, and no boss roster for these raids was established.

Hyjal Crater is an arena-type record. It does not verify Hyjal Summit. Empty journal tables and partial NPC data also limit what this search can establish.

Announced destinations

Nine dungeons and two raids in the official panel recap. The evidence column describes this client snapshot.

New map & encounter records

14 map IDs absent from both baselines. The five maps with encounter entries contain 26 new encounter names. These may include optional, rare or unfinished encounters; counts are not a final boss lineup.

Familiar bosses under new IDs

The other eight new encounter IDs reuse Sunken Temple names. They are excluded from the 26 new-name count.

Additional area clues

New area records around Hyjal, Krol’dok Stronghold and The Shaper’s Terrace. Area records alone do not establish an instance or raid.

Game versions

  • Forever: 1.60.1.69876 · September 17, 2026.
  • Classic: 1.14.4.51395 · Before Season of Discovery.
  • SoD reference: 1.15.9.69722 · Used to identify existing seasonal content.

Comparison labels

  • New set ID: absent from both Classic and SoD.
  • Changed Classic set: changes to the set name, pieces or bonuses.
  • Classic Tier 1 reference: the original Tier 1 set for the same class.
  • New encounter name: absent from the Classic and SoD encounter lists.
  • Dungeon-type map: a map marked as an instance in the client, including quest instances.

Sources & downloads

Set pieces and bonuses, maps and boss names come from the Forever client data. Raid and dungeon announcements link to Blizzard’s official recap.
